rule: Pin and location references expand exactly from the dictionaries; all semantic fields retained.

source_hypotheses.required: Full geometric End=B over the actual L-prime, original normalized family and same-r_5 modular form.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The first-family field1236-1245, branch1315-1324, kernel1410-1416 and call1438-1442.
source_hypotheses.justification: Separate BETA-FULL-END, END-FIELD, NORMALIZED-FAMILY and SAME-R5 identify these inputs.

constructed_objects.required: The original beta-family and original matrix-unit factors.
constructed_objects.constructed: The first beta-family A/K, L=EK, its original L-prime, finite B-linear mu_sigma, positive a_sigma, beta, matrix-unit factors r_ell and the same primitive form f. No discriminant-210 b-family input is used.
constructed_objects.justification: The accepted beta proof identifies different matrix-unit choices by conjugation commuting with rho.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every rational coefficient ell, including2; local restriction for every p with ell different from p.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The current family explicitly ranges over all ell; each comparison excludes a finite set.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The universal matrix-unit proof and beta comparison supply the entire domain without changing T.

transition_maps.required: Correct twisted relative Frobenius and scalar factor, followed by actual local restriction.
transition_maps.constructed: u_p=reduction(mu_sigma) composed with relative p-Frobenius; trace factor a_sigma/(2 beta(sigma)).
transition_maps.justification: The maps are actual isogenies; no unrecorded denominator is dropped. The accepted proof identifies specialization before trace transport.

consumed_object_identity.required: The actual U_f,ell, not only its semisimplification, and the original r_ell.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Same f from the original r_5; original primitive factor in rho_ell.
consumed_object_identity.justification: Absolute irreducibility plus the trace criterion gives composition length one; no new twist or family is substituted.

coefficient_conventions.required: Covariant rational Tate modules over a common finite extension retaining original embeddings.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: C is enlarged with f coefficients and original embeddings are extended.
coefficient_conventions.justification: All comparison isomorphisms are after this scalar extension; invariant dimensions and conductors are preserved.

local_conditions.required: Full local Galois representation comparison for ell different from p.
local_conditions.constructed: Restriction of the actual global isomorphism to the same decomposition group.
local_conditions.justification: This identifies inertia and higher ramification. The separate direct-Carayol application owns level equality.

exceptional_cases.required: Non-CM branch, ell=2, finite bad-prime exclusions and ell=p distinction.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Current branch selects fullEnd=B; characteristic-zero coefficients allow every ell; trace specialization uses ell different from p.
exceptional_cases.justification: Finite comparison exclusions do not affect the global isomorphism or change the controlled support T.

downstream_consumption.required: Local-isomorphism input to the primitive-level comparison and current conductor bound.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Current1477-1481 and1532-1544 use this family; Jacobian placement has its own supplier.
downstream_consumption.justification: Compatibility supplies only actual local isomorphism and conductor equality with U_f,ell. Direct Carayol supplies v_p(N), and separate bounds supply the numerical inequality.
